subject: Disappointed with my visit to your Ningbo Tianyi store
body:
Hi,

I'm writing because of how things went at your Ningbo Tianyi store earlier this week. I came in specifically to pick up something from your food section, and when I couldn't find it on the shelf I asked a staff member for help. The person I spoke to barely looked up, said they didn't know, and walked off. I waited around a bit and asked someone else, who was a little more helpful but still couldn't tell me whether it was out of stock or just not carried there.

I've shopped at your stores before and usually the service is fine, so this stood out. I left without what I came for and honestly it put me off coming back to that location. I don't need a big explanation, but I did want to let you know, since I doubt I'm the only one who's had this experience.

Thanks for reading.
